# 🏠 caliga_hall
Documentation relating to the spooni_caliga_hall.
https://spooni-docs.pages.dev/doc_mappings/lemoyne/spooni_caliga_hall

## 1. Installation
spooni_caliga_hall works Standalone.  

To install spooni_caliga_hall:
- Drag and drop the resource into your resources folder
  - `spooni_caliga_hall`
- Add this ensure in your server.cfg
  - `ensure spooni_caliga_hall`
- At the end
  - Restart the server

If you have any problems, you can always open a ticket in the [Spooni Discord](https://discord.gg/spooni).
